text:
lina: @sam planning to flip the feature flag for /v2-infer in eu1 tonight at 18:00 UTC. low-risk rollout but want a quick ops handshake. who can own push + watch? :wave:

sam: I can push and monitor. I’ll be online from 17:50-19:30 UTC. will hand to jay for post-rollout checks. :+1:

jay: I’ll watch latency/errs and run smoke checks. pls remind me of the quick cmds.

kira: FYI safe defaults are set: flag default = false, fallback model = redwood-small, prefix-cache off for eu1 during rollout.

lina: timeline proposal: 18:00 flip to 1% canary -> 18:10 to 5% -> 18:30 to 20% -> 18:50 to 100% if healthy. 10m observation windows. rollback on any regression.

sam: agreed. who is on-call for infra if we need to scale GPUs? @devops-bot can you standby?

devops-bot: devops on standby. escalation path: @devops on-call -> infra lead. Will pre-warm 2x pool at 17:40 UTC per request.

deploy-bot: scheduled window created: 2026-05-02 18:00 UTC (eu-west-1). Runbook link: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/rollouts/2798765432

jay: smoke checklist (quick):
```
# smoke checks
curl -sS 'https://api.redwood.ai/v2/infer?model=redwood-rl' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=inference --tail=200 | tail -n 50 | grep -i error
# metric checks: p50, p95 token latency; error rate over last 5m
```

kira: add a config guard: if p95 > 700ms OR error_rate > 1% during any observation window, stop and rollback to safe defaults. manual rollback command: `./tools/ffctl set /v2-infer false --env=prod`

lina: also add kill switch in Console: toggle `v2-infer-kill` set to ON to force fallback to redwood-small. link: https://console.redwood.ai/flags/v2-infer-kill

sam: copy. I'll post status updates in this thread at flip, after each canary bump, and on final cutover.

jay: I'll run the smoke cmds at 18:05, 18:15, 18:35, 18:55 and paste short results. watch metrics dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/infra/infer-ops?orgId=1

lina: roll-forward criteria: no latency regression >20% and error_rate delta <0.2% across windows. rollback criteria: any of the configured thresholds hit or customer-facing errors >0.

sam: prepping deploy notes now. will ping when ready to flip. quick ping for reviewers: @kira please ack the safe defaults and rollback steps. :eyes:

kira: acked. I’ll be reachable if we need to toggle additional per-tenant limits.

lina: thanks all. small reminder: announce to #support 5m before final 100% flip so CS teams can expect potential noise.

sam: will do. flipping at 18:00 UTC unless anyone objects in next 10m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: action queued: pre-warm infra at 17:40 UTC, notify on completion.

jay: quick note — if we see token throughput drop, increase batching cap back to 64 via `config set batching.max_tokens=64 --env=prod` (we had a temporary cap to 32 for canary).

lina: perfect. leaving this thread as the single source of truth for roll logs. post any short outputs here (one-liners). good luck. :rocket:
